task: ae.mc explicit-state model checker with deadlock/invariant/eventually checks, example protocols and brute-force oracle tests
reasoning_summary: BFS discovers states level by level so counterexamples are shortest; liveness builds the reachable graph, runs iterative Tarjan on the non-goal subgraph and BFSes to the nearest cycle or stuck state. First run failed a differential test because deadlocks were judged on dequeue; judging at discovery fixed it. Verified against distance-relaxation and EG greatest-fixpoint oracles on random graphs.
